title: Sebastian and the Summit
author: Marguerite Yarrow
blurb: Isandro Vane, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
